subject: Game Theory
title: Business as a Game
description: A 60-second lesson on Business as a Game.

hook.text: Every business decision depends on what competitors, customers, and regulators will do. That's a game.

buildup.text: Game theory gives firms tools to anticipate rivals' moves and choose the best response.

discovery.text: The key insight: your optimal strategy depends on others' strategies, not just your own preferences.

twist.text: But firms don't play once. They interact repeatedly, creating patterns of trust, rivalry, and signaling.

climax.text: From pricing to patents, mergers to marketing, game theory explains why firms behave as they do.

punchline.text: Business is strategy against living opponents.

quiz.question: What makes business a 'game' in game-theoretic terms?
